title: Explicit test case status
requirement: The Test cases panel must show each case's lifecycle status explicitly, not only as an unlabeled chip among metadata.
reason: UI requirement; the panel fix is not implemented yet, so no observed passing surface exists.
steps: Inspect a mixed list containing verified, unverified, stale and deprecated cases.
Read the status on each list row and in the detail heading without relying on position or colour alone.
expected: Each case row and the detail heading shows a labelled status, and the status is visually distinguishable from kind, source and automation metadata.

history.notes: Observed in the real Tasks → Test cases panel; usability-proof.mjs exit 0

observation.output: PASS every list row has a visible Status label | 12 rows; PASS status words are labelled, not bare chips; PASS detail heading explains its status
